title: withdupe
description: Duplicate items to quickly go through modpacks
body:
Item duplication is a vulnerability present in almost all modpacks. Allowing the use of item duplication to complete a modpack offers a gameplay style distinct from normal playthroughs. However, many item duplication glitches require a large amount of repetitive operations, reducing the game's enjoyment. This data pack provides several easy methods for simulating item duplication glitches:

- **Any version**: if the player looks down and throws an item, the item count will become 64.
- **Minecraft 1.17 and newer**: the quantity of items in your off-hand will automatically be the quantity of one stack (e.g., snowballs will become 16).
- **Minecraft 1.17 to 1.20.4**: When sneaking, the number of items in your off-hand will automatically become 64.



In addition, ~~to balance the game's difficulty,~~ a "killer" system has been added: when you try to open a loot chest, a large number of "killers" will try to stop you. Killing the "killers" will allow you to obtain the loot inside the chest.

The killer is extremely dangerous: the killer can also "**duplicate**". If you don't confine the killer to a closed space, allowing it to "**duplicate**" uncontrollably and relentlessly, it will take over the entire world. If there are no weapons of mass destruction, the only solution is to use the /kill @e command.
